Let’s Launch Your Academic and Career Goals
Pursuing your master’s degree can give you a professional edge in your industry, and taking on the challenge at UAH is a smart choice. Why? Because we consistently offer the highest financial return on investment (ROI) compared to all colleges in Alabama, both public and private.
In addition to being a great investment, UAH is known as a premier research institution with competitive master's and doctoral degree programs, from engineering to nursing. So what are you waiting for? Start today to get ahead.

Step 1
Discover UAH
We want you to feel thrilled about coming to UAH, so take time to explore what we offer. Included among our points of pride are our top-tier academics, vibrant campus life, exciting athletics programs, and the Rocket City we call home.
Discover UAH Explore Programs Explore Campus
Unique Opportunities at UAH
Take advantage of the incredible opportunities UAH has to offer. Chargers are curious, driven, and hardworking, which means they are on the front lines of research, embracing ways to level up their careers, and looking toward the future with an inclusive, global mindset. See how our students pursue their passions.
Be at the Forefront of Research
UAH is a nationally renowned doctoral-granting, research-intensive university.
Advance Your Career with an Online Degree
Our online degree options combine a world-class education with the flexibility you need.
Explore International Opportunities
Stand out from the crowd by gaining a global perspective as you work toward your degree.
Step 2
Apply for Graduate Admission
We make UAH graduate admission easy. We’ll walk you through the process, outline the application requirements, and make sure you don’t forget any important documents along the way.

Step 3
Apply for Financial Aid
Want to know what types of financial aid exist and what you may be eligible for? Curious about UAH’s cost of attendance? We can help answer your questions and ease you into the financial aid application process.

Straightforward Financial Aid
Your focus should be on getting the best education at UAH—not on how you’re going to pay for it. UAH offers a wide range of scholarships, grants, loans, and work-study opportunities. Our Office of Financial Aid aims to take the guesswork out of what aid you’re eligible to receive and help you find a financial aid package that works for you and your family.
Step 4
Prepare & Enroll
Once you’re admitted, the next step is to officially enroll. Our Charger Checklist will guide you through the final requirements so you’re prepped for your first semester at UAH, starting with New Student Orientation.

Receive Your Admission Decision and Join UAH
Congratulations on advancing your degree with UAH! We look forward to giving you all the experiential career advantages and opportunities available at a world-class research institution in one of the top college towns in the South. We cannot wait for you to contribute to our student body at the graduate level and connect with our committed faculty. Your future starts now!
Hear from Our Students
Pursuing my graduate degree here at UAH has been such an amazing decision! UAH is very well connected with industry to ensure job security and the professors are very knowledgeable in their areas of research! There are also many student organizations to get involved with, even at a graduate level!
Delores Baker
Ph.D. Electrical Engineering
Graduate studies at UAH offer more than just advanced education; they provide the opportunity to work closely with top-tier faculty, engage in cutting-edge research, and collaborate with peers who inspire you to achieve your best. The hands-on experience I’ve gained has prepared me not only to excel in my field but also to make meaningful contributions to it.
Justin Brown
Ph.D. Industrial & Systems Engineering
